## Changes

### Unified error taxonomy — [#180](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/180), [#179](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/179), [#172](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/172), [#174](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/174), [#167](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/167)

- **Error taxonomy**: introduce a unified `VCLErrorCode` taxonomy that classifies failures by validation phase — link/connectivity, client request authorization, issuer/verifier DID resolution, registration checks, and issuer/verifier request validity and authorization — replacing the previous platform-specific codes, with a general `sdk_error` fallback.
- **VCLError diagnostics**: add request and validation context to `VCLError` (`sourceErrorCode`, `validationPhase`, `requestDid`, `requestUri`, `requestKind`) plus native cause and call-stack-symbol diagnostics, and add `errorCodeCompatibilityMode` (`Taxonomy` default, `Legacy` fallback) on `VCLInitializationDescriptor`.

## Backward incompatibilities

- By default the SDK now returns the new taxonomy codes and populates validation-phase and request context on `VCLError`. Set `errorCodeCompatibilityMode` to `Legacy` to keep the previous codes.
- Malformed JWTs now fail during strict decode with `JWT must contain header, payload, and signature`; previously `VCLJwt(encodedJwt:)` accepted malformed values, so flows continued until later failing during DID resolution (empty `iss`) or public-JWK lookup (empty `kid`).
